videos.title: This speaker took on gerrymandering in her state — and won! #TEDTalks
videos.author: TED
videos.description: You don't need political power to make real change, says activist Katie Fahey. She tells the story of how she led a successful movement in Michigan to end gerrymandering — the practice of drawing district lines to favor one political party — and how it all started with a simple social media post.
